name: Innkeeper Grosk
summary: At Razor Hill, Innkeeper Grosk welcomes travelers on the road between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar. His inn offers food, drink, and a place to rest in central Durotar.

sections.title: Hospitality in the Red Wastes
sections.body: Razor Hill links Durotar’s southern training grounds with Orgrimmar’s high walls. Innkeeper Grosk shelters warriors, scouts, and peons at his inn. Travelers find basic provisions, hearty meats, and cool water beneath its sturdy timbers.

sections.title: A Peon's Respite
sections.body: Grosk also helps the laborers who keep Durotar running. Ukor, a timid peon, hauled food to the Valley of Trials only to learn it was not needed. He asks travelers to carry the load back to Grosk’s inn in Razor Hill.

faq.answer: Innkeeper Grosk is inside the inn at Razor Hill, in central Durotar on the main road north to Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Grosk provide?
aliases: can i bind hearthstone at razor hill
faq.answer: Grosk offers Horde travelers a place to bind their Hearthstone in Razor Hill. He also sells basic food, water, and meat to replenish health and mana between travels.

faq.q: Does Innkeeper Grosk offer any quests?
faq.answer: Grosk receives the food Ukor asks travelers to carry back to Razor Hill. Ukor feared Durotar’s beasts too much to bring it himself.

angles.text: For newly blooded orcs, trolls, and visiting tauren, Grosk’s inn is the first true town and hearth location on the road north from the Valley of Trials or Sen'jin Village toward Orgrimmar.
